Lighting and treatment: soft daylight from the left on a cream bench; a daylight lab or an everyday room, clean and exact, cream background #E9E3D3, ink #1B1E24, one blue #2F5BFF accent, soft strobe-ghost stamps, premium editorial science documentary look, clearly a code-rendered illustration rather than a photograph. Scientific accuracy: the bottom of a hanging slinky stays still for about 0.3 seconds after release because the news of the release travels down as a wave; the top falls first. Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real photograph or a news image.
